acceptanceCriteria.command: legion gh -- pr view <pr-number> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke --json files --jq .files  (expect one file smoke.txt with additions 1, deletions 0)
acceptanceCriteria.negativeControl: A diff touching a second file or adding more than one line fails AC1; the implementer must reduce the diff to the single appended line before opening the PR.
acceptanceCriteria.text: The pull request shows exactly one changed file, smoke.txt, with exactly one line added.

acceptanceCriteria.command: legion gh -- api repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/contents/smoke.txt --jq .content | base64 -d  (or git show main:smoke.txt) — the appended marker line is the final line
acceptanceCriteria.negativeControl: If the file on main does not end with the marker line, AC2 fails; the merge did not land the change.
acceptanceCriteria.text: After merge, smoke.txt on the main branch ends with the appended marker line.

notes: Plan and spec content live only in .legion/plan.json and the Dispatch issue document; no plan or spec file is committed to the repository. The planners only commit is plan: record handoff.

implement: legion-worker: governs the implementer push/PR procedure (bookmark legion/S390384725-1, push, PR body Dispatch: S390384725-1) and the E2E-proof discipline that proves AC1 on the real PR surface. No domain engineering skill applies: the change is a one-line append to a plain-text file with no build, framework, or test harness.
review: legion-worker: defines the reviewer round discipline, thread dispositioning, thermonuclear pair, and the in-scope allowance to request one more appended line to smoke.txt on the same PR. No language- or framework-specific review skill applies to a single plain-text line.
test: legion-worker: defines the tester proof contract (verify the implementers proof by re-driving the same surface, record implementerProof and the E2E (tester) line). No unit/integration test surface exists for a plain-text append; the git PR view and merged main are the only surfaces.

risks: smoke.txt may not exist yet; the implementer creates it with the single marker line rather than failing (spec Errors table).
A review may ask for one more appended line; that second line lands on the same PR and same file, not a new issue.
summary: Append one smoke marker line to smoke.txt at the root of github.com/sjawhar/legion-smoke, delivered by one implementer on one pull request, and carry it through the full Legion review/merge lifecycle. Done when the PR shows a single-file, single-line diff to smoke.txt, it merges, and that line is the final line of smoke.txt on main.
surface: The production-like surface is the real github.com/sjawhar/legion-smoke repository and its pull-request lifecycle: the PR Files-changed view proves criterion 1, and the merged main branch proves criterion 2. There is no local unit surface; the git repository itself is the surface.

tasks.ordering: Single implementer commit; no cross-file dependencies. If the reviewer asks for one more line, append it to the same smoke.txt on the same PR (in-scope per spec).
steps: Fetch current smoke.txt at repo root; if it does not exist, create it holding only the single marker line (per spec Errors table).
If it exists, append exactly one marker line to the end (single added line, no other edits).
Choose a short, unambiguous smoke marker line (spec leaves exact wording to the implementer).
Commit on the issue workspace, set bookmark legion/S390384725-1, push, and open the PR with body containing the line Dispatch: S390384725-1.
Prove AC1 on the PR Files-changed view and record it as the E2E (implementer) line and the implement handoff proof array.
Verify the implementers proof by re-driving the PR Files-changed view for AC1 (one file, one added line).
Record implementerProof verdict and add the E2E (tester) proof line.
Verify CI, Threads, and E2E facts on GitHub directly; run the thermonuclear pair once at the final head.
May request one additional appended line to smoke.txt (in scope for this same PR per spec Requirements table).
After a human merges, verify AC2: smoke.txt on main ends with the appended marker line via git show main:smoke.txt (or the contents API).

verificationEvidence.implement: PR Files-changed view shows one file smoke.txt, +1/-0; recorded as E2E (implementer) at the PR head SHA with a negative control (a broken multi-file/multi-line diff rejected).
verificationEvidence.merge: git show main:smoke.txt after merge shows the marker line as the final line (AC2).
verificationEvidence.test: Tester re-drives the PR Files-changed view for AC1 and records implementerProof.verdict.
